name: How long does it take to frame a new window rough opening?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to frame a new window rough opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing a standard window rough opening in a typical wood-frame wall generally takes one to two days. However, the total project timeline expands depending on what sits inside the wall and the full scope of finish work. If hidden electrical wiring or supply plumbing runs through the framing bay, rerouting trades must step in before framing wraps up. Additionally, complete restoration includes exterior flashing, weatherproofing, hanging new drywall, taping, mudding, and installing custom interior trim and paint, which usually extends the full renovation process to several days.
acceptedAnswer.description: Carpentry framing usually takes 1 to 2 days, while trade relocations, exterior flashing, drywall patching, and finish trim extend total completion over several days.
